decision: What we measure at Book and pay
options: Booking completions per class, with drop-off at payment
Revenue per booking by pass type
Time from opening page to paid booking
recommendation: Booking completions per class, with drop-off at payment
reason: It shows which classes fill and where people give up, which is what we'd act on.

recommendation: Count of class views that lead to a booking start

decision: What we keep from Cancel before cutoff
options: Count of cancellations per class with hours before start
Cancellation reason chosen from a short list
Keep nothing beyond the booking status
recommendation: Count of cancellations per class with hours before start
reason: It shows whether the cutoff is right and how many spots reopen, with no extra personal data.

decision: What people can buy: single drop-ins, class packs, memberships

decision: Whether people pay online when booking or at the studio

recommendation: Pay online at booking
reason: Paying upfront makes the spot real, cuts no-shows and gives the confirmation step something firm to promise.
